race.comment: MAKETIME (3) returns for the McEvoy yard and will be trying to repeat his debut win over 1400m at Wangaratta to kick off last prep. Has jumped out well at Flemington behind a couple of smart ones in readiness and maps to be blending in nicely when they straighten. Bold showing anticipated. ROYAL INFANTRY (8) has just missed in both runs back here. Strips fitter and only needs to improve a smidge to get the verdict this time. VAGABOND HERO (1) gave backers a bold sight when resuming here last time, only to tire close to the line and finish fourth. Is sure to trim down following that and gets the 3kg claimer on to help the big weight. Should prove tougher to reel in this time. VILNIUS (5) never looked likely last time at Geelong when always well back but his two runs prior were solid. Has since gone back to the jumpouts. Wary of sharp improvement. Keeping safe.
